sites_https_justification: The project homepage, the source repository and the development distribution are all served over HTTPS: https://pagerankr-63ad30.gitlab.io/ , https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr and https://bart-turczynski.r-universe.dev/pagerankr .
description_good_justification: DESCRIPTION and the project homepage succinctly describe pagerankr as an R toolkit for PageRank modelling on crawl and analytics data: https://pagerankr-63ad30.gitlab.io/
interact_justification: The project homepage https://pagerankr-63ad30.gitlab.io/ links to the source repository, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md and the issue tracker. Contribution instructions are at https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md and the issue tracker is https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/work_items
contribution_justification: The README sends bug reports and enhancement requests to the GitLab tracker (https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/work_items) and points contributors at CONTRIBUTING.md (https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md), which describes the feature-branch and merge-request flow and the gate every change must pass.
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents the requirements for an acceptable contribution: no lintr findings, no spelling errors, a NEWS.md heading that matches DESCRIPTION, and R CMD check --as-cran passing with no errors or warnings, enforced by the pre-push gate: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
license_location_justification: The license is at the repository top level: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/blob/main/LICENSE (the CRAN two-field stub) and https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/blob/main/LICENSE.md (the full MIT text).
floss_license_osi_justification: MIT is an OSI-approved open source license: https://opensource.org/license/mit
documentation_basics_justification: Basic documentation covers installation, getting started and usage. The README and the pkgdown site (https://pagerankr-63ad30.gitlab.io/) carry installation and quick-start instructions and worked examples; the usage tutorial vignette is at https://pagerankr-63ad30.gitlab.io/articles/pagerankr-usage.html . SECURITY.md describes the untrusted inputs the package handles and how to report a problem with them: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/blob/main/SECURITY.md
documentation_interface_justification: Every exported function has roxygen2-generated reference documentation describing its arguments and return value: https://pagerankr-63ad30.gitlab.io/reference/index.html
repo_public_justification: The source is in a public git repository on GitLab: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr . The GitHub repository github.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr is a read-only mirror.
repo_track_justification: All source changes are tracked in git: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/commits/main
repo_interim_justification: Interim development commits are publicly available between releases on the main branch: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/commits/main
repo_distributed_justification: Uses git, a distributed version control system: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr
version_unique_justification: Each release has a unique version number in the DESCRIPTION Version field. The first release, 0.1.0, is awaiting CRAN acceptance.
version_semver_justification: DESCRIPTION's Version uses the x.y.z scheme (currently 0.1.0), with a fourth .9000 component reserved for development versions.
version_tags_justification: No release has been published yet: 0.1.0 is awaiting CRAN acceptance and no tag exists. The GitLab pipeline is configured to run on v* tags (.gitlab-ci.yml, https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/blob/main/.gitlab-ci.yml), and releases will be tagged there: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/tags
release_notes_justification: NEWS.md documents the user-facing changes for each release, and the pipeline checks that its top heading matches DESCRIPTION's Version: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/blob/main/NEWS.md
release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known vulnerability has been fixed to date. NEWS.md records every user-facing change: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/blob/main/NEWS.md
report_tracker_justification: The project uses GitLab work items as its public issue tracker: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/work_items
report_process_justification: Bug reports go to the GitLab issue tracker (https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/work_items), named in the README and in DESCRIPTION's BugReports field.
report_responses_justification: No bug reports have been filed on the GitLab tracker yet. The maintainer monitors the tracker and responds to reports there: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/work_items
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement requests have been filed on the GitLab tracker yet. The maintainer monitors the tracker and responds to requests there: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/work_items
report_archive_justification: GitLab keeps reports and responses publicly archived and searchable at https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/work_items
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: The vulnerability-reporting process is published in SECURITY.md: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: SECURITY.md (https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/blob/main/SECURITY.md) sends private reports to the maintainer's email address, or to a confidential GitLab issue restricted to project members.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability reports have been received. SECURITY.md commits to acknowledging a report within 7 days and coordinating a fix and disclosure: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/blob/main/SECURITY.md
build_justification: The package builds with the standard R CMD build and R CMD check toolchain; the reproducible CI configuration is https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/blob/main/.gitlab-ci.yml
build_common_tools_justification: It uses the standard R package build tooling (R CMD build, R CMD check) and GitLab CI.
build_floss_tools_justification: R and its build toolchain are free/open-source software: https://www.r-project.org/
test_justification: The FLOSS testthat suite is public and runs as part of R CMD check: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/tree/main/tests/testthat
test_invocation_justification: Tests run with devtools::test() or testthat::test_local(), and as part of R CMD check, which CONTRIBUTING.md documents as the gate: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
test_most_justification: Line coverage measured by covr in the GitLab coverage job is 99.89% on main (2026-09-24): https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/pipelines
test_policy_justification: The policy is informal and applied in practice: new functionality ships with its own testthat file, and coverage on main is 99.89%. CONTRIBUTING.md requires the suite to pass under R CMD check before a push: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
tests_are_added_justification: Recent major functionality shipped with focused testthat files, for example hits(), salsa() and trustrank() with test-hits.R, test-salsa.R and test-trustrank.R: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/tree/main/tests/testthat
tests_documented_added_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires the test suite to pass but does not yet state in writing that new functionality must come with tests: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
warnings_justification: lintr and R CMD check surface warnings in the pre-push gate and in the GitLab pipeline on every push to main: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/blob/main/.gitlab-ci.yml
warnings_fixed_justification: The pre-push gate and the pipeline's check job fail on any R CMD check warning, and the gates job fails on any lint, so warnings are fixed before merge.
warnings_strict_justification: The gates job sets LINTR_ERROR_ON_LINT=true so any lint fails the pipeline, the check job fails on warnings, and the local gate runs R CMD check --as-cran: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/blob/main/.gitlab-ci.yml
know_secure_design_justification: The package defensively processes untrusted URL, redirect, crawl, and link-graph data.
know_common_errors_justification: Input validation and tests cover malformed inputs, redirect loops, and graph edge cases.
crypto_password_storage_justification: pagerankr stores no passwords or credentials.
crypto_random_justification: pagerankr does not generate security-sensitive random values.
crypto_used_network_justification: pagerankr makes no outbound network connections. The optional launch_explorer() serves a local Shiny app through shiny::runApp().
crypto_tls12_justification: pagerankr does not establish network connections.
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: pagerankr does not establish network connections.
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: pagerankr does not establish network connections.
delivery_mitm_justification: Source and development builds are delivered over HTTPS only, from GitLab (https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr) and r-universe (https://bart-turczynski.r-universe.dev/pagerankr).
delivery_unsigned_justification: All distribution downloads are served over HTTPS (GitLab, r-universe); no hash is retrieved over plain HTTP: https://bart-turczynski.r-universe.dev/pagerankr
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: There are no known vulnerabilities, and none are outstanding. SECURITY.md defines the response process; the tracker is https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/work_items
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No known unfixed critical vulnerabilities exist.
static_analysis_justification: lintr, the common R static analysis tool, runs on the whole package in the pre-push gate and in the gates job of the GitLab pipeline: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/blob/main/.gitlab-ci.yml
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: lintr and R CMD check find defects but are not vulnerability scanners. The osv-audit job checks the runtime dependencies against OSV, but it is SCA, not static analysis of pagerankr's code, and it runs only when DESCRIPTION, test-osv.R or .gitlab-ci.yml change on main, or when started by hand.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: The pre-push gate and the pipeline's gates job fail on any lintr finding, so static-analysis findings are fixed before merge.
static_analysis_often_justification: lintr runs on every push: the verification gate is a pre-push hook, and it runs again in the GitLab pipeline on every push to main: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/pipelines
dynamic_analysis_justification: No dynamic analysis tool (fuzzer, sanitizer or valgrind) is run. pagerankr is pure R with no compiled code.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: pagerankr is pure R with no compiled code (no src/ directory), so it contains no memory-unsafe code.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The testthat suite's expectations are assertions checked at runtime on every run of the pre-push gate and the GitLab pipeline: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/tree/main/tests/testthat
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No dynamic analysis is run (see dynamic_analysis), so there are no findings to fix.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: The GitLab CI pipeline (https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/pipelines) runs lint, spelling, R CMD check, coverage and the rurl floor check on every push to main. The same gate runs as a pre-push hook on every branch before it leaves a contributor's machine.
discussion_justification: Discussion happens on GitLab issues and merge requests (https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/work_items), which are public, searchable and addressable by URL, and need no proprietary client software.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: No credentials are committed. A gitleaks scan of the full git history (481 commits across all refs, 2026-09-26) found no leaks: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr
english_justification: Documentation and issue-tracker interaction are in English (DESCRIPTION declares Language: en-US): https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr#readme
hardening_justification: Hardening mechanisms such as HTTP response headers apply to web applications; pagerankr is an R library.
sites_password_security_justification: pagerankr operates no site that manages user passwords.
maintained_justification: The project is actively maintained, with current development and a pipeline on every push to main: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/pagerankr/-/commits/main
